version_map_status: proposed editorial mapping pending owner confirmation

version_map.V1: Historical RC hauler baseline; source-specific legacy labels retained
version_map.V2: Current physical reconstruction and reliability/instrumentation; manual RC scope
version_map.V3: Future assisted/autonomous concepts; no fitted capability implied

unresolved_current: actual installed power topology and ratings
dimensions, payload/runtime limits, ingress and safety validation

issues.source_claims: V2 variously means autonomy, assisted collection, payload integration or reliability retrofit.
issues.resolution: Use distinct axes: V1 historical baseline, V2 current physical reconstruction/reliability/instrumentation, V3 future concepts. This editorial mapping is proposed for owner confirmation; legacy labels remain source-qualified.

issues.source_claims: Mega in V1/V2 posters; Nano in V3, old repo; Nano/Pico in BOM.
issues.resolution: Current owner-confirmed controller is Elegoo Uno R3. Kits, Mega, Nano and Pico are historical alternatives, not current installed identity.

issues.source_claims: Pi 4 in BOM/posters; Pi 3B in research report.
issues.resolution: Raspberry Pi model remains conflicting; no Pi-specific current rating or enclosure fit is confirmed.

issues.source_claims: 18V generic/Milwaukee posters; V3 poster says 18V and Kobalt 24V MAX.
issues.resolution: Retain Kobalt 24V family as owner project scope. Pack label, capacity and voltage range remain unverified. Never substitute an 18V/20V-family cutoff.

issues.source_claims: BOM calls KB624-03 a fuse switch.
issues.resolution: Official Kobalt documentation identifies KB 624-03 as a battery-pack model. Remove it as the switch/adapter part number. Physical pack identity still requires a label.

issues.source_claims: BOM lists two; photos show one photographed adapter.
issues.resolution: Record source-listed quantity 2 separately from installed quantity unknown. No inference of two fitted power feeds.

issues.source_claims: Source lists 5V 10A and separate 5V 3A converters; R0 drew only one.
issues.resolution: Add U5A secondary 5V source-listed candidate to architecture/power/connectivity and BOM. Leave output/load unconnected and never parallel outputs by assumption.

issues.source_claims: 10A/3A/5A labels presented as installed ratings.
issues.resolution: Treat as source-listed specifications, not verified output capability or measured load. 12V converter remains proposed/source-listed, not confirmed fitted.

issues.source_claims: Generic 30A auxiliary and 60-80A traction fuses; mixed 5A/10A/15A kit.
issues.resolution: No installed fuse rating is established. Remove generic values from the active design; size against actual conductors, loads, connectors and source limits after verification.

issues.source_claims: Some guides mandate common ground while others call the domains isolated.
issues.resolution: Separate source positives; actual returns and crossing signals must be traced. No RC/auxiliary ground tie or galvanic isolation is asserted.

issues.source_claims: External buck discussed historically; research proposes Pi USB power.
issues.resolution: USB-A-to-B is the proposed data link. Uno external VIN/barrel/5V entry and simultaneous USB power remain unresolved; do not add a duplicate supply path.
issues.physical_follow_up: Trace both power entry routes and actual USB cable.

issues.source_claims: Generic reference permits 3S/4S; integrated spec retains 3S.
issues.resolution: Retain 3S as current project design scope. Actual pack and installed ESC limits remain verification items; no 4S change is adopted.

issues.source_claims: Prior chat review mentioned RWD; research rejects a stock transmitter 2WD mode.
issues.resolution: Stock SCX6 is 4WD with a two-speed transmission. Installed driven axles remain unknown until mechanical modifications are inspected; high/low gear is not 2WD/4WD selection.
issues.physical_follow_up: Inspect shafts/axles and document any modifications.

issues.source_claims: Historical HC-SR04; research says lost and recommends A02YYUW.
issues.resolution: Record HC-SR04 as historical; present installation/replacement unknown. A02YYUW is a proposal, not a drop-in trigger/echo replacement.
issues.physical_follow_up: Owner confirms sensor fitted or absent; inspect model.

issues.source_claims: Replacement discussed beside HC-SR04 code.
issues.resolution: Manufacturer SEN0311 uses 9600-baud UART, not trigger/echo. Do not connect it to the HC-SR04 harness or enable that driver. Replacement needs its own pin/power/protocol review.

issues.source_claims: BOM claims heading; old schema includes yaw/enclosure temperature.
issues.resolution: MPU raw axes and die-temperature counts do not establish absolute heading or enclosure temperature. Keep raw acquisition; no calibrated angles, compass or enclosure readings are invented.

issues.topic: Camera GPS lidar encoders and PCA9685
issues.source_claims: Posters depict them; guides discuss purchases and integration.
issues.resolution: Classify as historical inventory claim or future proposal. Fitting, deployment and current part identity are unknown; exclude them from current mandatory wiring and actuator control.

issues.source_claims: Posters advertise autonomy, classification, return to base, anti-jam intake and dual bins.
issues.resolution: These are future concepts. Current source package is RC-observational acquisition; no deployed autonomy, powered intake, physical sorting or manipulator is established.

issues.source_claims: Checkmarks/coloured symbols with no legend; ✔❌ ambiguous; footer rows shifted.
issues.resolution: Preserve raw rows as source catalog. Use explicit evidence status and separate listed/proposed quantity from verified installed quantity. Deduplicate shifted tail rows; never total ambiguous quantities as actual inventory.

issues.source_claims: 15-20kg safe continuous; posters 10-25kg; 15lb/20lb development plan; 50/60lb objectives.
issues.resolution: No validated modified-vehicle payload rating exists in the supplied evidence. Preserve these as separate source targets. Rough total litter collected is not simultaneous payload capacity.

issues.source_claims: Posters advertise 2.4-3.6h, 0-1.5 or 1-5m/s, 15-25kg and 80-95cm dimensions.
issues.resolution: All are concept targets/estimates without current measurement. They do not populate measured CAD, runtime or operating-envelope cells.

issues.source_claims: Posters label entire electronics system IP67; guides recommend sealed hardware.
issues.resolution: A component rating does not qualify the assembled enclosure/vehicle. Actual glands, seals, modifications and ingress tests remain unknown.

issues.topic: Current geometry versus Rev B/trailer proposal
issues.source_claims: Photos show raised cart; consolidated reference calls rail pods, four-post/five-truss Rev B and tractor/trailer adopted.
issues.resolution: Keep raised-cart reconstruction as current historical geometry. Rev B cradle, rail pods, closed ring, removable-module Case 4 and passive trailer remain source-described proposals, not fitted parts.

issues.source_claims: BOM lists 11.5 x 7.5 x 5.1in; R0 CAD used 210 x 130 x 90mm placeholder.
issues.resolution: Record source candidate as 292.1 x 190.5 x 129.54mm, not measured. Use it only as an explicitly source-listed layout envelope; actual box identity/fit remains unknown.

issues.source_claims: Stock width/wheelbase and poster totals are mixed with CAD values.
issues.resolution: Keep stock product specs, source candidates, illustrative layout and measured dimensions in separate fields. Overall width is not automatically tyre-centre track spacing.

issues.source_claims: Review calls clips 2/4/5/7 four independent failures and assigns 90-92% confidence.
issues.resolution: Source itself describes clip 5 as same route/analysis and clip 7 as repeated event. Do not count four independent experiments or treat subjective confidence as measured probability. Preserve source claims and require unique original evidence IDs.

issues.source_claims: Review and data workbook mark pavement Approved with unnamed approval evidence.
issues.resolution: Demonstrated travel is not a released operating envelope. Keep historical observations but no current approval, load limit or reviewer sign-off is inferred.

issues.source_claims: Integrated spec reports a simulated panel and unanimous decisions.
issues.resolution: Simulation is design reasoning, not approval by actual reviewers. Requirements remain candidate requirements until owner/review adoption is recorded.

issues.source_claims: SYS-001 etc mean different requirements across integrated and offline references.
issues.resolution: Preserve legacy IDs with source namespaces IPDS0: and OFFLINE1:. Do not join or score solely on the bare ID.

issues.source_claims: Blank measured scores calculate 0%, triggering Kill/Repurpose; safety says Pending/Pass.
issues.resolution: Guard missing/invalid scores and evidence. Default becomes Pending evidence, not a failure or pass. Distinguish critical failures from noncritical category failure.

issues.topic: Scorecards mix legacy and current configs
issues.source_claims: Historical source assessments drive dashboard as current data.
issues.resolution: Filter dashboard and requirement summaries to CFG-V2-R1. Preserve historical rows and source-reported outcomes separately; no current physical pass rate exists without measured results.
Retain source-scoped candidate thresholds; no arbitrary global threshold is declared approved. Current draft firmware is 100ms/10Hz coupled acquisition, not a 50-100Hz validated stream.

issues.source_claims: Research proposes CSV D/heartbeat lines; old repo JSON synthetic; R0 introduces strict JSON v2.
issues.resolution: Use documented proposed JSON protocol v2 for the new code only. Preserve existing raw firmware output first; no claim that original code uses it. Legacy CSV requires an explicit adapter, not silent parser fallback.

issues.source_claims: Consolidated reference claims 113 CV tests; R0 has32 acquisition tests.
issues.resolution: These refer to separate codebases. 32 local draft acquisition tests are checked; 113 CV tests are source-reported/unverified here and do not prove deployed perception.

issues.source_claims: Research reports two-mile trip, ~10lb collected, lost sensor, unusable mount, no usable field data.
issues.resolution: Retain as report-attributed observations, not a verified new field dataset. Their dates/configuration and original ten videos must be linked before closing physical records.
issues.physical_follow_up: Obtain original run manifest/media or owner confirmation.

issues.source_claims: Research contains current verified prices; source reviews say May2026 without original run records.
issues.resolution: Treat prices as historical quotes/allowances, not new prices or purchase evidence. Source dates are document assertions, not verified test dates.

issues.source_claims: Existing diagrams/firmware could imply installed working logger and hardware protection.
issues.resolution: New sources are engineering drafts. Compile/replay/native validity checks are distinct from deployment, bench results, field reliability or physical protection.

issues.source_claims: Old R0 PDF exports would disagree after native edits.
issues.resolution: Freeze PDF bytes for this pass. Mark them stale for R1 and link current editable/SVG/STEP sources. Regeneration occurs only after owner review.
